books.title: The Orchard at Dusk
books.author: Mara Ellison
books.notes: A quiet novel about returning home. Save for a rainy weekend.

books.title: Salt Roads
books.author: Teodor Vance
books.notes: Halfway through. The chapter on the winter crossing is the best thing I've read this year — reread the lighthouse scene before book club on Thursday.

books.title: A Field Guide to Small Weather
books.author: Inès Okafor-Lindqvist

books.title: The Cartographer's Daughter and the Long Year of Unmapped Rivers
books.author: Hollis Marchetti
books.notes:
Recommended by Priya.
She said to skip the prologue and come back to it at the end; the map in the endpapers matters more than it seems.

Long, slow and worth it. Probably a summer book.

books.title: Glasshouse Letters
books.author: Ruth Abernathy
books.notes: Epistolary, two sisters, one greenhouse. Read a letter a night.

books.title: Nine Lanterns
books.author: Kenji Arobe
books.notes: Finished in two sittings. Lent my copy to Sam.
